markup:
For a typical **12V portable compressor fridge (30–60 liters)**, I recommend a **500–1,000Wh portable power station**, depending on how long you want to run it without recharging.

## Recommended power station size

Assuming your fridge averages 15–25 watts over a full day, including compressor cycling:

| Power station capacity | Estimated fridge runtime |
|---|---|
| 256Wh | 9–15 hours |
| 300Wh | 11–18 hours |
| 500Wh | 18–30 hours |
| 768Wh | 28–46 hours |
| 1,000Wh | 36–60 hours |
| 2,000Wh | 3–5 days |

These estimates assume approximately 90% usable battery energy through a DC connection. Actual runtime depends heavily on ambient temperature, insulation, thermostat setting, and fridge efficiency.

## My recommendation

- **Day trips:** 300Wh
- **Overnight camping:** 500Wh
- **Weekend camping (2 days):** 1,000Wh
- **3–5 days off-grid:** 2,000Wh or a smaller station with solar charging

Use the power station's **12V DC output** rather than its AC outlet when possible. This avoids inverter losses and can significantly improve runtime.

## Calculate your exact requirement

{@body const [watts,setWatts] = DIL.useState(20)}
{@body const [hours,setHours] = DIL.useState("48")}
{@body const required = Math.ceil(watts*Number(hours)/0.9/50)*50}
<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <text weight="medium">Fridge average power consumption</text>
  <row align="center" justify="between">
    <text color="secondary" size="xs">5W</text>
    <title size="lg" color="default" tabularNums>{watts}W</title>
    <text color="secondary" size="xs">60W</text>
  </row>
  <slider min={5} max={60} step={5} value={watts} onChange={setWatts}/>
  <text weight="medium">Desired runtime</text>
  <radio-group direction="col" value={hours} onChange={setHours}>
    <radio value="12">12 hours</radio>
    <radio value="24">24 hours</radio>
    <radio value="48">48 hours</radio>
    <radio value="72">72 hours</radio>
  </radio-group>
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <text color="secondary" weight="medium" size="sm">Estimated minimum battery capacity</text>
  <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>{required.toLocaleString()} Wh</title>
  <caption>Assumes DC operation and 90% usable capacity. Add a reserve for hot weather and unexpected power consumption.</caption>
</box>

**Two questions to size it more accurately:**

1. What portable fridge do you have (brand/model or capacity in liters)?
2. How long do you want it to run without recharging — 12 hours, 24 hours, 2 days, or longer?

With those details, I can recommend a more precise battery capacity and power station size.
